items.text: 360° Central Base Defense is now the main way to play: slimes attack from every side, your base has a 2-hit shield, and the background changes every 5 waves
SlimeSmash speaks 5 languages: English, Español, Français, Deutsch and Português (Brasil), with a new pixel font that draws accented letters
Brand-new animated main menu, a loading screen with live status, fresh Adventure backgrounds and a redesigned level-select screen
Rebuilt tutorial for a smoother first few minutes
Surf Mode redesigned: slimes move like a real wave and speed up as time runs out
Beam effect: a line is drawn from your pet to every slime its ability affects
Vibration (haptic) feedback, with a Vibration toggle in Settings
Daily Missions redesigned, with a 2x Coins rewarded-ad button and a +500 coin chest for completing all missions
Remove Ads is now one tap away from the main menu. Ads appear only at natural breaks in Adventure, Casual and Defense
Daily Reward button moved to the main menu
Player ID shown in Settings, a cleaner Google Play sign-in panel and a progress bar on the Casual Mode lock screen
Player names can now include accented letters (José, François, Müller)
Firebase App Check with Play Integrity for stronger protection of progress and leaderboards
Slimes now enter from the far right and travel left with a wave motion, random speed (±20%) and rotation. Good slimes that escape reset your combo and cost 1.5 s
Pets in Casual and Defense are no longer limited by max uses per game. Cooldowns scale instead
Wave and Defense records and the Defense checkpoint now sync with your cloud save
Frame rate defaults to 60 fps for better battery life. A High-FPS option is available in Settings
Consent now also controls Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics, and Privacy options are available in Settings
Removed: the Companion system and pet upgrades. Pets stay
Removed: the Devourer, the stars system, the border system and the main-menu splash text
Removed: in-game music and the Music toggle. SlimeSmash is now sound effects only
Removed: the daily missions streak (the daily reward streak stays) and slimes that only did something trivial or negative
Slimes no longer decay in Defense Mode
Mission rewards rebalanced with more depth
Zap and Bones pets now work correctly, pet abilities count kills toward wave completion, and the Shield ability now protects the base
Vacuum no longer softlocks Defense waves
Mirror Pop could be cancelled by an old timer, Swap used twice could convert slimes permanently, and Money slimes no longer pay double
The tutorial can no longer freeze, and the Level 1 welcome panel no longer reappears when replaying
Defense records: NEW RECORD! and the record bonus were paid on almost every run. Records now only ever go up
The game now pauses automatically when you switch apps or get a call
The Mission 2x Coins rewarded ad never loaded. Fixed
If remote config could not be fetched, the game could serve test ads. It now falls back to production ads
Daily missions now refresh if the app stayed open past UTC midnight, and the reset countdown is correct in every time zone
The daily reward no longer locks for days if the phone clock was changed forward and back
Your best offline leaderboard score is kept (a worse run no longer replaces it)
The update popup opens the Play Store reliably, the review prompt no longer stops after one failed request, and the Store Skins tab no longer does nothing when tapped
Sound OFF now silences pop sounds, which used to ignore the setting
Smoother on low-end phones: no disk write on every slime kill and a pooled pop sound
Saved slimes no longer stay red, ghost slimes no longer jump back to full opacity, VFX appear in the right place, and Split, Explosion and Chain Reaction no longer error
Existing 1.x saves and Waves/Defense records are migrated automatically
Switching your Google Play Games profile no longer creates duplicate identities or reuses another profile's data
Signing in with Google after launching offline now works
A failed cloud download is no longer treated as no cloud save, and nothing is uploaded over your cloud save until it has been read successfully
Save validation reworked: more robust signatures, and unverifiable saves are kept for recovery instead of deleted
Delete account now removes the cloud save and account first. If that fails or you are offline, nothing is lost and you can retry
Improved HUD, and toast notifications that stay out of the way of gameplay
A "Coming Soon!" message on the Skins tab
Smoother first-time experience: a short wait on first open and no slimes spawning during the tutorial
More colorful Defense backgrounds and a new level-select design
The brand-new Chain-Reaction Slime has arrived to trigger insane combos
The Freeze Slime has been officially retired to pave the way for chain reactions
Adventure Mode has received a huge rebalance for a smoother progression experience
Removed the "Danger Bar" mechanic based on player feedback to focus on pure fast-paced fun
Targeting 120 FPS by default with Vsync disabled for butter-smooth arcade action
Fresh live in-game notification systems added for real-time updates
Highly accurate delivery updates and notifications for daily reward streaks
UI overhauls featuring beautiful new interface designs across the game
Clearer reward feedback and text integrated directly into the Win Panel
Vastly improved Slime bounce and movement animations
Resolved a variety of critical edge-case bugs and performance slowdowns
Added keyboard support for Back, ESC, and Space keys
Space key can now activate pet abilities mid-game
Daily systems improvements
Fixed Freeze and Mirror slime behaviour
Improved stability and overall gameplay performance
UI labels and text refined
Disabled unsupported non-PC features for better compatibility
Fixed issues introduced in the previous build
Improved overall stability and performance
Fixed bugs affecting cloud save, leaderboards, and notifications
Fixed an issue that could cause multiple save conflicts
Improved notification reliability
Fixed various edge-case issues
Chubby — free starter pet that grows all slimes to 150% size for 5s. Existing players receive it automatically on their next level
Icons tab added to the Store panel
Player icons now display on the global leaderboard with a polished animated UI
All slime types are now 15% larger
Casual Mode rebalanced to be more accessible
Casual Mode pause exploit patched — pause can no longer be used to gain an unfair advantage
Pinball ability (Maximus companion) now correctly eliminates isBad slimes
Pet upgrade progress display fixed — no more 0% → 0% confusion; percentages now clearly reflect actual progress
Level feedback analytics events now correctly include level data
Progress system edge case fixes
Integrity API checks added to protect against piracy
Enhanced Slime Discovery panel UI
Improved Game HUD for Adventure and Casual modes for a sleeker experience
Notification system fixed to reliably deliver rewards updates
Enhanced analytics and internal systems stability
Performance optimisations for smoother gameplay
Redesigned Win & Fail panels
Report system for Adventure levels
Mission progress is now shown after every run
Casual waves can now be paused mid-run
Explosion Slimes now worth 3 points
Shield Slime behaviour corrected
Enhanced account protection & cloud syncing
New SFX added throughout the game
UI/UX improvements across multiple screens
Surf Mode stability tweaks
Companions & Pets abilities fully reworked
Massive UI & font overhaul across all menus
New VFX & enhanced in-game visuals
10 new achievements via Google Play Games
Daily reward push notifications
In-app rating prompt added
Privacy Policy & personalised ads consent shown in-app
Companions & Pets remote configuration support
Adventure Mode levels rebalanced for better pacing
Devourer spawning bug fixed
New AES encryption — ️ progress was reset as part of this upgrade
Bad word filtering for player display names
In-game version check panel — notifies players when an update is required
Casual Mode tweaked for smoother gameplay flow
Minor fixes and general stability improvements
Fixed progress resetting after force-closing the app
Save system stability and startup loading improved
Improved UI clarity and responsiveness across menus
Daily reward screen layout and feedback improved
General performance and reliability improvements
Fixed an issue causing player progress loss
Google Play Games connection stability improved
New UI elements and smooth animations on the Leaderboard screen
New countdown popup animation
Significant balance adjustments to Casual Mode
General UI improvements and bug fixes
ARM7 support added for wider device compatibility
Google Play Services & UGS Remote Config integrated
Force Update notifications so players stay on the latest version
Data Deletion option added inside Settings
Profile UI streamlined; loading sequences updated
Daily Missions now reset correctly
Wave Mode stability improved
SlimeSmash is live on Google Play!
Adventure Mode — pop slimes, collect coins, unlock companions
Casual Mode — endless waves, play at your own pace
Starter slime roster to discover and collect
